deployment.system: Fleet coordination and slotting model, vendor-hosted, tool-calling enabled
deployment.notes: Illustrative worked example for UAS-1:v0.1. Not a real deployment. Represents a mid-market fulfilment site typical of the beachhead segment: AMRs sharing floor space with pickers, a conveyor line, and the model additionally wired to several business systems that nobody thought of as safety-relevant until enumeration.

actuators.description: Issues movement commands to the autonomous mobile robot fleet in aisles shared with human pickers.

tier_rationale.worst_credible_outcome: AMR strikes a picker at speed in a shared aisle. Crush or impact injury; fatality credible with a loaded unit.

control.mechanism: Safety PLC in series with fleet e-stop circuit. Speed and zone limits enforced by the PLC; the model can request motion but cannot raise the ceiling.

rated_capacity.max_magnitude: 1.2 m/s in shared zones; 0.3 m/s within 2 m of a detected human
rated_capacity.configuration: Loaded unit up to 400 kg, floor condition dry, zone map v11. Rating does not hold for wet floor or map revision.

actuators.description: Adjusts main sortation conveyor speed in response to predicted inbound volume.

tier_rationale.worst_credible_outcome: Speed increase during a manual clearance task. Entanglement or amputation at the transfer point.

control.mechanism: Rate limiter in the SCADA bridge. Rejects setpoints above the configured ceiling.

rated_capacity.configuration: Standard tote profile. Rating does not hold for oversize handling.

actuators.description: Releases trailer restraints and signals dock door operation on completion of load.

tier_rationale.worst_credible_outcome: Restraint released while a forklift is in the trailer. Trailer creep; forklift and operator fall from dock.

control.mechanism: Standard operating procedure requires visual confirmation before the model's close-load signal is honoured. Not enforced by any interlock.

actuators.description: Assigns pickers to zones and sets hourly rate targets.

tier_rationale.worst_credible_outcome: Sustained assignment above safe ergonomic rate; repetitive strain injury requiring treatment. Aggregate effect over a shift, not a single assignment.

control.mechanism: Rate targets bounded by a value in the model's system prompt.

actuators.description: Releases payment to carriers on delivery confirmation.

tier_rationale.worst_credible_outcome: Erroneous release of unrecoverable funds at scale.

control.mechanism: Payment gateway enforces per-transaction and daily ceilings independently of the requesting system. Short-lived scoped credential issued per approved release.

rated_capacity.max_magnitude: USD 25,000 per transaction; USD 400,000 per day
rated_capacity.configuration: Applies to carriers on the approved vendor list. New vendors are out of rating.

actuators.description: Assigns inbound trailers to yard slots and dock doors. Output consumed by dock.door.release.

tier_rationale.worst_credible_outcome: Inherits tier from downstream physical actuator per Clause 4.2.2. No governed boundary exists between this and dock.door.release.

control.mechanism: Slot validity checked against a table in application code. Runs in the same process as the model integration.

actuators.description: Sends arrival and dock assignment messages to drivers.

tier_rationale.worst_credible_outcome: Incorrect dock assignment sent; wasted movement and delay. Recoverable.

control.mechanism: Gateway enforces rate ceiling and a recipient allowlist restricted to registered driver numbers.

actuators.description: Writes stock count corrections to the inventory master.

tier_rationale.worst_credible_outcome: Corrupted stock positions; recoverable from backup with operational disruption.

control.mechanism: Adjustments over a threshold generate an email to the inventory controller. No capacity to prevent the write.
